title: Andrei Rublev
description: Andrei Rublev is a vast and vivid episodic epic that tells the story of a Russian monk and painter of religious icons during the time of the Tartar invasions.

title: The Sun Never Sets
description: The Sun Never Sets in Alaska (in the summer), but love affairs don't last forever in this affectionate indie rom-com with Dakota Fanning.

title: Union County
description: In the addiction recovery drama Union County, Will Pouter and Noah Centenio are foster brothers trying to get free of their dependence on opioids.

title: Hanging by a Wire
description: The Himalayas, Aug 22, 2023: a cable car bearing 8 passengers is left hanging by a wire 900 feet above the ground when two out of three cables snap.

title: Filipiñana
description: Filipiñana features a luxury golf course in the Philippines in this striking composed comedy which mixes languid surrealism with pointed political satire.

title: Once Upon a Time in a Cinema
description: Once Upon a Time in a Cinema covers a fateful eve at the local fleapit in East Limerick, when Richard Gere is on screen but the cinema is on its last legs.

title: American Doctor
description: American Doctor is a powerful documentary set in Gaza, filtered through the eyes of three American surgeons compelled to do their utmost to alleviate harm.

title: The Second Ascent: An Ultra Trail Running Story
description: In The Second Ascent, ultra-runner-turned-race director Gary Robbins and his Coast Mountain Trail Running team attempt to launch a 100km race in Valemount.

title: All the Lovers in the Night
description: Based on Mieko Kawakami's acclaimed novel, All the Lovers in the Night is a tender, luminous portrait of loneliness, intimacy, and the courage to be seen.
